description: This file defines the InitialLoadingScreenClass, which manages the display and lifecycle of a loading screen component in a web application, including animations, timing, and cleanup.

classes.name: InitialLoadingScreenClass
classes.description: A class that controls the display, animation, and removal of the initial loading screen in the application.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the loading screen elements and starts the loading process.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the loading screen, or destroys it if running in a desktop app.

methods.name: handleAnimationEndEvent
methods.description: Handles the end of animation events to trigger cleanup.

methods.name: addAnimationEndListener
methods.description: Adds event listener for animation end.

methods.name: removeAnimationEndListener
methods.description: Removes event listener for animation end.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the loading screen and cleans up resources.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins showing the loading screen and animation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the loading screen, measures load time, and transitions to loaded state.
